summary:
Full-Stack Telegram MTProto Backend & WebRTC Voice Gateway Implementation Plan:
1. Backend MTProto Engine (server.ts): Express server utilizing GramJS ('telegram') for direct MTProto 2.0 communication with Telegram Data Centers using user's API ID and API Hash.
2. Real Telegram Auth API: Endpoints for /api/telegram/send-code, /api/telegram/sign-in, and /api/telegram/me with encrypted StringSession generation.
3. Telegram Voice Chats & WebRTC Gateway: Real MTProto phone.createGroupCall and phone.joinGroupCall integration coupled with WebRTC audio streams for real-time group voice rooms.
4. Client Integration: Connecting TeleSpaces UI with the live full-stack backend routes, live DC connection monitor, and session persistence.
